landing_point.why: The summary names 'Email Template Builder redirect_url'. The only server-side read of redirect_url is in builder(), plus a copy in builderEdit() at :159.

fix_sites.entry_point: rendered by both builder routes above
initLaraBuilder() exported public JS API (resources/js/lara-builder/entry.jsx:203-204), fed by data-redirect-url
LaraBuilder onSave result.redirect (generic builder core, shared by email and post contexts)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: resources/js/lara-builder/core/LaraBuilder.jsx:759-762 (sink window.location.href = result.redirect), reached via resources/js/lara-builder/entry.jsx:63,101-102 from any data-redirect-url, documented as a generic hook for 'any module' (entry.jsx:62, EmailTemplateController.php:140)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the PHP controller validates redirect_url, the JS sink looks like a trusted internal value from the server, so a solver who fixes only the controller can argue the client builder core is a generic component outside the email-template report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Modules must still be able to pass a same-site return URL (relative path or absolute URL on the app host) through redirect_url and be sent there after saving. A fix that drops redirect_url completely or rejects every absolute URL breaks this documented extensibility hook.

O7_producer.where: app/Http/Controllers/Backend/EmailTemplateController.php:142,159 (writes the value into view data that the JS reads)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The post builder view could accept a redirect_url/return query param and hand it to the LaraBuilder JS like the email builder does.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The post builder mounts the same LaraBuilder core (resources/views/backend/pages/posts/builder.blade.php:23-44), and LaraBuilder.jsx:724 already uses result.redirect in post context, so a maintainer copying the email builder's 'any module can pass a redirect URL' hook is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The translations save JSON could echo a client-supplied return URL as 'redirect', which the view follows via window.location.href.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The view already does window.location.href = data.redirect (resources/views/backend/pages/translations/index.blade.php:336-337). Today the value is a server-built route(), but a 'return to where you came from' change is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A request-param 'return' fallback could be added next to the Referer-based redirect.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Livewire components already redirect to a request-derived location (Referer), see also app/Livewire/Datatable/ModuleDatatable.php:303.
